description: Build the trusted v2 decision runtime and durable API: server-owned context/consent, strict event-time features, deterministic B0/B1 policy, SQLite PAUD atomicity, institution-bound principals, v2-only HTTP cutover, and record-only actions/feedback.
steps: Implement backend/app/storage/preauth.py with DecisionStore, SQLiteDecisionStore, and demo-only MemoryDecisionStore; integrate backend/app/state.py and backend/app/security/audit.py with WAL, synchronous=FULL, busy timeout, recovery/checkpoint, tenant-qualified reservations/idempotency/tombstones, leases/generation fencing, retention, and PAUD hash-chain atomic commits.

Implement backend/app/context/preauth.py as the only provider of server-owned current events, registered fixtures, consent outcomes, verified beacons, institution denominator, hub state, participation, local sufficiency, context snapshots, and injected clocks; enforce the exhaustive ConsentOutcome matrix and no silent cross-to-local downgrade or timeout upgrade.

Add backend/app/detection/features_contract.py and update motifs/preauth to use one strict earlier-than-subject history primitive, b0.v2/motif.v2 hashes, exact equations/policy/uncertainty, safe UNKNOWN, and the local-only step-up ceiling; keep frozen v1 imports isolated.

Replace backend/app/api/preauth.py and related auth/dependency/middleware code with a v2-only route, unsupported-schema UNKNOWN handling, tenant-scoped idempotency, generic wrong-tenant 404s, strict action/feedback receipts, PAUD-backed decisions, and no legacy order/freeze/report imports.
Add context, feature, storage, API, tenant, action, crash, restart, and retention tests; update only the v2-facing tests while retaining the v1 evaluator regression.
acceptance_criteria: POST /preauth/decisions rejects earlytrace.preauth.v1 and caller prior_events/as_of/hub/participation/arbitrary beacon/acct_ fields with stable 410/422 before scoring; v1 exists only in the offline evaluator.

Feature history is event_id != current.event_id and occurred_at < current.occurred_at for B0, B1, HGB/calibration, evaluation, and explanations; feature_as_of is attested subject time and server_now cannot expand it.

SQLite PAUD is the sole authoritative ledger; one transaction commits reservation/decision/idempotency/receipt/audit, and crash/fencing tests prove no duplicate final row or unaudited acknowledgement.
Consent outcomes, participation, action expiry/eligibility, same-hash replay, conflicting-hash 409, feedback quarantine, and immutable decisions match the locked design.
